* '''Original''' ([[Mustafar]], 7 January 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (8 January 2019). Players Committee card image, 7 January 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-mustafar-original.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/mustafar.gif Holotable commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images”], no mark). Text: Light Side: “While Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Mustafar site.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Mustafar (Errata)]], 10 January 2019): Players Committee card image, 10 January 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-mustafar-20190110.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/36439e0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/mustafar.gif Holotable commit 36439e0 “Flipping Mustafar for GEMP”], no mark). Text: Light Side: “While Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Mustafar site.” '''What changed:''' the same card image stored upside down (turned 180°); the words and mark are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Mustafar (Errata 2)]], 18 March 2021): Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-mustafar-20210318.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/mustafar.png Holotable commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata”], mark “E”). Text: Light Side: “If Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “While Anakin or Vader here, gains one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon.” '''What changed:''' Light Side: “While Vader on table” became “If Vader on table”. Dark Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Mustafar site.” became “While Anakin or Vader here, gains one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon.” '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
* '''PC-E3''' (this page, 18 March 2021): Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-mustafar-20210318-rotated.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/703095c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/mustafar.png Holotable commit 703095c “Rotate locations”], mark “E”). Text: Light Side: “If Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “While Anakin or Vader here, gains one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon.” '''What changed:''' later the same day, the errata image was stored again turned 180° ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/703095c commit 703095c “Rotate locations”]); the words and mark are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
*: [[File:V10-D-mustafar-20210318-3-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Mustafar (Errata 4)]], 19 August 2024): Players Committee card image, 19 August 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-mustafar.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/mustafar.png Holotable commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered”], mark “E1”). Text: Light Side: “If Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “While Anakin or Vader here, gains one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 10 remaster: same words; mark now “E1” (was “E”), new art (credit “Image courtesy of Djebrayass @ DeviantArt”) and copyright line (“ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”). Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 4 by release order (PC-E4); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
